children: China electric vehicle maker's Q2 revenue rose 69% yr/yr on 49% higher vehicle deliveries
Gross profit more than tripled yr/yr; gross margin improved to 18.4% from 10%
Net loss narrowed sharply; company posted small adjusted net profit for the quarter
NIO expects Q3 deliveries between 108,000 and 111,000 vehicles
Company sees Q3 revenue between RMB33,285 mln and RMB34,051 mln
NIO says it is confident in achieving full-year operating objectives
DELIVERY VOLUME - Co said higher vehicle deliveries across NIO, ONVO and FIREFLY brands drove revenue growth
PRODUCT MIX - Co attributed higher vehicle margin and average selling price to more favorable product mix
COST STRUCTURE OPTIMIZATION - Co said ongoing optimization of cost structure supported margins despite rising cost pressures
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 21 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the auto & truck manufacturers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for NIO Inc. is $7.18, about 69.7% above its August 31 closing price of $4.23
The stock recently traded at 87 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 146 three months ago
